summary_bullets: Commit tracked leftovers before drop-bump in run_rebase_rebump so Guard 1 cannot spuriously stall (#3209)
Re-check round-mode commits for pre-commit-hook residue with a one-shot follow-up commit
Add offline regression tests for both defenses and document the behavior in script siblings
commit_message:
Fix drop-bump stall on dirty tracked tree during CI rebase (#3209)

Option A: ship-pr run_rebase_rebump commits tracked leftovers before drop-bump-commit.sh. Option B: review-and-fix round mode performs a guarded one-shot follow-up when hooks re-dirty the tree after the round commit.
